parameters.query: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.client_id, u.username, u.email, u.role, u.full_name, u.is_active, c.hospital_name, c.client_code, c.destination_name FROM shreeji_app.users u LEFT JOIN shreeji_app.clients c ON u.client_id = c.id WHERE (u.username = $1 OR u.email = $1) AND u.password_hash = crypt($2, u.password_hash) AND u.is_active = TRUE;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, message: 'Logged out successfully' }) }}
